# RealEstate-Analytics.ai

> CCIM-grade, deterministic real estate deal analysis for investors, agents, lenders, and financial planners. Free browser-based calculators plus a Pro plan with deal lead sourcing, comps, and full deal reviews. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Tools
- [Quick Deal Analyzer](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/#quick-analyzer): Multi-metric rental deal evaluator — cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, IRR, equity multiple, 10-year projections, PDF report.
- [Cap Rate Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/cap-rate-calculator): NOI divided by purchase price, with deal grading and 2026 benchmarks.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/dscr-calculator): Debt service coverage ratio and lender qualification.
- [Break-Even Occupancy Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/breakeven): Occupancy and rent needed to cover operating expenses and debt service.
- [IRR Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/irr-calculator): Internal rate of return and equity multiple over a hold period.
- [Cash-on-Cash Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/cash-on-cash-calculator): Annual levered yield on invested equity.
- [Tenant Credit Analysis](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/tenant-credit): Rent-to-income and DTI screening for applicants.
- [Lease Type Analyzer](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/lease-type): NNN vs. gross vs. modified gross.

## Guides

## Pricing
- [Free](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/pricing): Interactive calculators and PDF deal reports, no signup.
- [Pro — $45/month](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/pricing): Deal lead sourcing, comps, and CCIM-grade full deal reviews.
